name: the sandbox
intro: REGISTRY QA BAY 3. Every device in here is under test.
One bench per thing the system can do. The console by the door puts it all back.

readables.name: TEST PLAN · BAY 3
pages: BAY 3 · DEVICES UNDER TEST. STATIONS 01–10, LEFT TO RIGHT: NOUN KINDS, CABLES, GUARDS, SEALED SECTORS, TRACE, THE NET, WATCHDOG, EVERYDAY USE, PEOPLE, TIME AND WEATHER.
EACH STATION HAS A TEST CARD. RESET BAY 3 RETURNS EVERY DEVICE TO ITS FIRST STATE. TESTERS ARE NOT RESET.

readables.name: BAY 3·01 · NOUN KINDS
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: NOUN KINDS. ONE DEVICE PER KIND, LEFT TO RIGHT: SENSE (MOTION SENSOR), ACT (TEST LAMP), STORE (MEMO SCREEN), LINK (WALL PORT), DAEMON (UNIT 7), CLOCK (METRONOME), LOG (TAPE RECORDER).
TEST: TAP EACH. WAVE AT THE SENSOR: ITS PRE-WIRED CABLE SWITCHES THE LAMP. TALK TO UNIT 7. STOP THE METRONOME IN HACK VIEW. OPEN THE RECORDER AND WATCH ITS TRACE.

readables.name: BAY 3·02 · CABLES
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: CABLES. THE TEST BUTTON FANS OUT: ONE EVENT, THREE CABLES (BEACON, HORN, COUNTER). THE COUNTER'S IS A FIXED CONDUIT: IT CANNOT BE CUT.
CHAIN: WIRE PLATE → TIMER (WAIT 2 S) → SWITCH (ON, PASS) → HATCH OPEN. THE HATCH IS PRE-WIRED TO THE FAN. TIMER AND SWITCH ARE IN THE LOGIC DRAWER.

readables.name: BAY 3·03 · GUARDS
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: GUARDS. QA LOGIN: PASSWORD, 2 TRIES, LOCKS 5 S, A NEAR MISS ("bay3"). THE STICKY NOTE PUTS BOTH ON YOUR KEYRING.
ONE GUARD PER LOCK TOY: SHIELD LOCKER (RINGS), CIPHER BOX (SHIFT 3), CRYPTEX CASE (A 4-LETTER WORD), MORSE LAMP (OK). PROBE EACH IN HACK VIEW. EACH TAG HAS THE ANSWER.

readables.name: BAY 3·04 · SEALED SECTORS
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: SEALED SECTORS. SECURE CABINET: DRAWER A, KEY SEAL (CUT A KEY CHIP AT THE CUTTER, DROP IT ON THE DRAWER). DRAWER B, SEQUENCE SEAL: RED, GREEN, BLUE ON THE PANEL, BY CABLE, WITHIN 3 S.
DRAWER C, CONDITION SEAL: OPENS WHILE THE MAINS LEVER IS UP. OPENED SECTORS ARE SAVED; RESET BAY 3 SHUTS THEM.

readables.name: BAY 3·05 · TRACE
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: TRACE. THE AUDIT DESK LOGS YOU AT 20% A SECOND WHILE YOU ARE INSIDE IT. A WRONG PASSWORD ADDS 30%. AT 100% YOU ARE OUT AND IT LOCKS FOR 8 S. THE METER ON THE WALL SHOWS IT.
WAYS OUT: CUT ITS CABLE TO THE SPOOL, SWITCH ITS LOG OFF, OR LOG IN ("auditor") AND WIPE IT FROM ROOT.

readables.name: BAY 3·06 · THE NET
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: THE NET. THE NET JACK IS ON THE TEST LAN. IT KNOWS QA-SRV 01; A SCAN FINDS QA-PRN 2. QA-VAULT IS ONE HOP ON, THROUGH QA-SRV 01'S OWN LINK.
PING QA-SRV 01: ITS CABLE RINGS THE BELL. PRINT ON QA-PRN 2: THE LABEL PRINTER PRINTS. THE TEST LAN IS ONLY REACHABLE FROM THIS BAY.

readables.name: BAY 3·07 · WATCHDOG
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: WATCHDOG. QA-WD WALKS STAMP PRESS → CONVEYOR → SIREN: 3.5 S ON EACH, 1.5 S BETWEEN. THE ONE IT SITS ON IS FROZEN: NO VERBS, NO SIGNALS. THE RED LAMP OVER A DEVICE SAYS WHERE IT IS.
EACH OF THE THREE HAS A WATCHDOG NOUN: WIRE ITS "leaves" TO SOMETHING TO ACT WHILE IT IS AWAY.

readables.name: BAY 3·08 · EVERYDAY USE
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: EVERYDAY USE. THE COFFEE MACHINE HAS THE FULL POPUP: THREE EVERYDAY ACTIONS, JACK IN, HACK IT.
ITEMS: TAKE A BLANK CHIP FROM THE DISPENSER (YOU CARRY IT: HELD), INSERT IT AT THE CHIP READER. TOKENS: THE TEST TILL TAKES ONE PER PAYMENT.

readables.name: BAY 3·09 · LIFE
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: PEOPLE, ROBOTS, ANIMALS. TALK TO THE QA LEAD AND THE NIGHT TECH (THE TECH ANSWERS DIFFERENTLY BY NIGHT AND IN RAIN). TALK TO TEST UNIT 0 WHILE IT WORKS. PET THE CAT.

readables.name: BAY 3·10 · TIME AND WEATHER
readables.label: [E] TEST CARD
pages: TIME AND WEATHER. THE NIGHT LIGHT IS PERMITTED 18:00–06:00 ONLY, AND GOES OFF BY ITSELF AT DAYBREAK. THE VENT REFUSES RAIN, STORM AND SMOG, AND SHUTS ITSELF WHEN THEY COME.
THE WEATHER SENSOR READS THE DISTRICT'S WEATHER. SIT ON THE BENCH TO WAIT UNTIL LATER. SUDO'S TIME CONTROL AND WEATHER OVERRIDE WORK HERE.

people.name: QA LEAD
talk: Bay 3. Every device in here has passed its test at least once.
Not at the same time. We do not test that.
The console behind me resets the bay. Devices, cables, trace, the lot.
It does not reset me. I asked. Twice. It logged both requests.
Left to right, one bench per thing the system can do. Read the plate, then break the thing under it.
Then log that you broke it. Then log that you logged it.
The watchdog in seven is ours. Well. It is the Registry's. We just feed it.

people.name: TEST UNIT 0
talk: CARRYING: 1 DEVICE UNDER TEST. DESTINATION: THE NEXT BENCH.
I HAVE BEEN TO THE NEXT BENCH. IT IS ALSO A BENCH.
MY JOB: MOVE THE TEST. MY TEST: WHETHER I MOVE THE TEST.
RESULT: PENDING. I AM MOVING IT.

people.name: NIGHT TECH
talk: I test the bench. Sit on it, wait, see if time passes. It does. Every time.
Forty-one passes. I am going for fifty.
The cat is not a device under test. We checked. It refused the checking.
TEST UNIT 0 has carried that same box between bays since I started.
I asked what is in it. It said: "THE TEST." Fair.

pages: Rain. The vent knows before the forecast does. I trust the vent.
The vent has never once said "light showers".
Night shift. The night light is allowed on now. It waited all day for this.
Same, honestly.
ONE BLANK CHIP DISPENSED. FREE OF CHARGE. LOGGED.
FOR THE CHIP READER, NEXT TO IT.

resettable.label: the sandbox
resettable.confirm: this resets the sandbox only (QA bay 3: devices, cables, parts, trace).
resettable.done: sandbox reset: QA bay 3 as on the first visit. Everything else is kept.
